LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.accountBeta.Desc: Replaced by 'Account interest: share of the market return'. Kept so older save games load; changing it does nothing.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.accountShare: Account interest: share of the market return
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.accountShare.Desc: A bank account only pays this fraction of the market's surplus (M - 1) a year, and never more than the savings product Mattress Plus (which follows the investment profitability). 0.2 means: at M 1.2 the account pays +4 % a year (the savings product Mattress Plus pays +8 %, the index about +20 %); at M 2 it pays +20 %. Below M 1 it loses a little, never more than 10 % a year. Both profitability sliders (this bank M and the investment M) are worth keeping close together. Each bank adds its own small bonus or malus. Investments are not affected.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.atmDailyLimit.Desc: The most silver you can take out of ATMs per day.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.bailout.Desc: The bank First Rim Bank of Too Big To Fail rescues a ruined former tycoon once per game year (an interest-free loan, not a gift).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.collectionAnger.Desc: Multiplies the size of seizure teams and collection raids. 0 turns the violent stages off.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.depositDelayHours.Desc: Silver put into the account without a bank counter or ATM nearby arrives after this many hours.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.directDeposit: Route till money straight to the bank
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.directDeposit.Desc: Once an account exists, the tills of your businesses are emptied into the account at midnight instead of leaving silver on the floor.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.directDepositFee.Desc: Fee on money that is routed straight into the account (till takings). 0 to 100 %.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.feeFactor.Desc: Multiplies all fees of your bank. 0 % = no fees at all.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.lateFee.Desc: Charged on the overdue instalment when a loan reaches collection stage 2.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.loanFloor.Desc: Minimum credit limit for a colony with a fine score, so a young colony can borrow a little.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.loanIntervalDays.Desc: Loan instalments are due every this many days.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.loanPortfolioShare.Desc: How much of your investments (at market value) counts as wealth when the bank decides how much you may borrow. 100 % = fully, 0 = not at all. The net worth shown in the lobby always counts them fully.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.maxCollectionStage.Desc: The collection ladder: 1 reminder, 2 late fee, 3 offset against deposits, 4 friendly visit, 5 seizure team, 6 collection raid, 7 bounty. Standard Room stops at 4: you pay your debt and lose nothing but a little mood.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.moodOn.Desc: A small thought (from -4 to +3, doubled for greedy colonists, none for ascetics) depending on the net worth per colonist.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.moodScale.Desc: Scales the net worth thresholds of the mood tiers (Broke … Too Big To Fail).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.podMaxLoad.Desc: A big withdrawal comes in drop pods of about this many silver each, never more than 10 pods per withdrawal (huge sums make heavier pods instead of more of them). It does not limit how much you can deposit or withdraw.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.podMinHours.Desc: Withdrawals without a counter or ATM come by drop pod after at least this long.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.profit.Desc: How much invested money grows on average per game year (60 days). This is the bank's own M: it drives the account interest and loan rates. The investment M (Investments page) drives the markets; the account never pays more than Mattress Plus at that M. Keep both close together. 1.0 = plus/minus nothing, 1.2 = +20 % a year, 0 = the money disappears. Log scale 0.01 to 100; type a number for the exact value. Follows the difficulty slider until you set it yourself.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.researchMode.Desc: Full: ATMs, night safes, branches and loans need their research. Off: everything is available from the start. (The global Research mode in the core settings does the same for every module.)
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.seizureShare.Desc: If the Black Ledger seizes your account (1 % risk per quadrum), this share of the balance is gone.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.sounds.Desc: Clicks, coin counting, stamps in the bank window, and the lottery win or lose sound when a draw you bought tickets for is held.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.switchFee.Desc: What it costs to move your account to another bank (KONZEPT 2.2: 50 silver).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.tradeDeposit.Desc: Off by default, so selling to a trader still hands you coins you can spend at once. With this on (and direct deposit on), silver you receive from traders and trade ships is moved into the account right after the deal (at the direct deposit fee). Caravans are not affected.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.wealthShare: Bank balance counts for the storyteller (%)
LanguageData.HH.Setting.bank.wealthShare.Desc: How much of the account counts towards the colony wealth that the storyteller uses for raid points. 100 % = fair: depositing money does not make raids smaller. 0 = the bank is a hiding place.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.abstinenceDays.Desc: Days without any session needed to cure each stage of the addiction (stage 3 = 3 × this).
Below this many sessions in three days nothing happens.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.addictionP0.Desc: Chance of addiction after the third session within three days; it grows ×1.35 with each further session. 0 turns addiction off.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.ambience.Desc: A soft murmur of voices, chips and distant slot bells in a busy casino room while the camera is near it.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.animSpeed.Desc: 100 % is the designed pace. Higher numbers play the games faster; holding Shift plays them at 300 %.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.animations.Desc: The Lucky Thrumbo and the practice games show the reels, the wheel and the cards in motion before the result. Off: the result appears at once. A click on the table, Space or Enter always skips the rest of an animation.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.blackjackH17.Desc: 0 = dealer stands on soft 17, 1 = dealer hits (about +0.2 points of edge).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.blackjackPays.Desc: 3:2 = 1.5, 6:5 = 1.2. Changes the house edge by about 1.4 points.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.chipSpendBonus: Spending bonus with a cashier's cage
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.chipSpendBonus.Desc: Guests bring this much more to the tables when a cage sells chips ("doesn't feel like money").
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.chipTakeHome.Desc: At most this share of a guest's winnings stays on them as chips when they leave: pure house profit ("chip float").
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.colonistChips.Desc: Colonists gamble with worthless house chips: no colony silver is ever lost at the tables.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.croupierRequired.Desc: Roulette, blackjack and Rimdeck only run for guests while a colonist with the Serving work type staffs the table. Slot machines never need one.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.fatalDespair.Desc: Reserved. Nothing in this module can kill a colonist; the switch has no effect.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.guestBetShare.Desc: A guest stakes this share of their gambling money per round. The default is larger than in a real casino because the tables run far fewer rounds per in-game hour; hourly takings stay about the same.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.guestBudgetShare.Desc: Share of a guest's remaining budget they bring to the tables (before personality).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.guestMinBuyIn.Desc: Guests with less to spend do not gamble.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.guestStopLoss.Desc: A guest leaves the tables after losing this share of their gambling money.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.guestWinTarget.Desc: A guest cashes out after winning this share on top of their gambling money.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.houseFloat.Desc: Cash the house keeps in its drawer. Whatever it wins above this (plus what guests currently play with) goes to the colony till when the casino closes.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.houseRiskLimit.Desc: Caps each bet at cash ÷ (4 · σ · √rounds per day): a bad night cannot break the house. The cap shrinks when the cash is low.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.howToSeen.Desc: Remembers that the short game explanations of the Lucky Thrumbo opened once by themselves. Turn it off to see them open again.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.joyGain.Desc: Joy gain compared with a vanilla poker table.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.maxBet.Desc: Largest stake at any game while limits are enforced.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.minBet.Desc: Smallest stake. Fractions are fine: the bet is not paid out in coins.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.pokerRake.Desc: The share of every pot the house keeps (up to the rake cap).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.pokerRakeCap.Desc: The most the house takes from one pot.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.reactions.Desc: Players cheer, groan and toss coins on wins, losses and near misses (small icons above their heads and short sounds).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.rouletteEdge.Desc: 0.54 % to 7.9 %: small edges use a la partage wheel, 2.7 % is one zero, over 4 % is a double-zero wheel. Every bet gets exactly this edge.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.roundsPerHour.slot.Des: How fast a machine spins, per in-game hour (2500 ticks, so 40 is a spin every 1 to 2 real seconds at normal speed).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.slotRtp.Desc: Share of the stakes a One-Armed Muffalo pays back in the long run. 92 % = house edge 8 %. Above 100 % the house loses money.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.tableLimits.Desc: On: bets stay between the minimum and maximum bet below. Off: only the house risk rule limits bets.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.toleranceFactor.Desc: How quickly joy tolerance builds up compared with vanilla (0.6 = 40 % slower).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.casino.worldFx.Desc: Spinning reels, the roulette wheel, dealt cards, chips and small sounds at the machines and tables while people play.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.cinemaCooldownHours.Desc: A guest sees at most one film in this time.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.cinemaMinSeats.Desc: A projector screen counts as a cinema when at least this many seats face it.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.cinemaShowTicks.Desc: How long one screening runs. 2,500 ticks are one hour.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.cinemaTicket.Desc: Price of one ticket. Guests pay when they sit down.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.desireScale.Desc: Scales how strongly guests want to go to the cinema, salon, gallery and park bench. 0 = never.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.galleryCooldownHours.Des: A guest goes through a gallery at most once in this time.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.galleryFee.Desc: Price of walking through the gallery once.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.galleryMaxViews.Desc: How many artworks one guest looks at per visit.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.galleryMinArt.Desc: A room counts as a gallery when it holds at least this many artworks.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.galleryViewTicks.Desc: How long a guest stands in front of one artwork.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.movieNight.Desc: Colonists organise a movie night now and then when a powered projector screen with seats exists.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.movieNightChance.Desc: Chance that the colony starts a movie night on a given evening (18:00).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.parkCooldownHours: Hours between bench visits per guest
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.parkCooldownHours.Desc: A guest sits on a bench at most once in this time.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.parkRestTicks.Desc: How long somebody sits on a park bench.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.priceTolerance.Desc: How much guests accept to pay for city services compared with the reference price. Follows the difficulty slider; 1 = standard.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.researchMode.Desc: Full: the City Life projects must be researched. Off: everything in City Life is available right away.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.salonCooldownHours.Desc: A guest gets at most one new look in this time.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.salonDyePrice.Desc: Extra for a hair colour change (needs Biotech or Ideology).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.salonPrice.Desc: What a guest pays for a haircut and a new style.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.salonServiceTicks.Desc: How long a haircut takes with an average stylist.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.salonWaitTicks.Desc: A guest waits this long in the chair for someone to turn up, then leaves unhappy.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.securityChance.Desc: Base chance per eligible guest; very wealthy guests (80+) get +40 points.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.securityDayShare.Desc: The bodyguard costs this share of the guest's budget per day, billed per hour.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.securityHireHours.Desc: A hire that finds no free armed colonist within this time is cancelled without charge.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.securityMinHourFee.Desc: A bodyguard never costs less than this per hour.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.securityMinWealth.Desc: Guests below this wealth level (1 to 100) never hire protection.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.securityOn.Desc: Wealthy guests may hire one of your armed colonists as a bodyguard.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.taxiArrivalChance.Desc: Share of arriving guests who are dropped off at the taxi stand instead of walking in from the map edge.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.taxiArrivalFee.Desc: What an arriving guest pays the colony for being set down at the stand.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.taxiDepartureChance: Chance to take a taxi when leaving
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.taxiDepartureChance.Desc: Share of departing guests who call a taxi when a free taxi stand exists (rises with wealth).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.taxiFare.Desc: What a departing guest pays for the ride from the taxi stand.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.city.taxiWaitTicks.Desc: How long a guest waits at the stand before the cab lifts off.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.guide.Desc: The learning helper at the top right. Right-click it to hide it.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.helpHint: Show the small real-life help hint where you gamble
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.helpHint.Desc: A small, quiet line on every screen where you yourself gamble: if gambling is a problem in real life, help exists (findahelpline.com). Never shown elsewhere.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.rngAlgorithm.Desc: Algorithm for all Hearth & Harbor random streams. Same odds for all, only the sequence differs. ChaCha8 is cryptographic (paranoid), SplitMix64 is fastest.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.core.sealedFate.Desc: On: reloading a save does not re-roll guest events (everything uses sealed random streams). Player bets, bank trades and lottery are always sealed.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.aiIdeoPrecepts: Also give AI ideoligions money precepts
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.aiIdeoPrecepts.Desc: Random AI ideoligions get a stance on indulgences and paid ascension once, weighted by their memes. Fixed faction ideoligions are never touched.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.fundDestination.Desc: To the deity: the silver simply disappears. To the faith's faction: if a faction shares the faith, it gains goodwill (+1 per 500 silver, at most +5 per quadrum). Colonists never pay into your own temple fund.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.indulgenceCapScale.Desc: Multiplier on the purchase limits per pawn, colony and ideoligion. 1 = limits as designed.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.indulgenceFactor.Desc: Multiplier on every indulgence and ascension price (the Faith-for-sale factor of the money-and-faith table).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.luckShift: Luck: payout shift of Lucky and Unlucky
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.luckShift.Desc: Lucky people get this many percentage points added to a game's payout plan, Unlucky people lose as many. The shift never lifts a game to 100 % or above and never bends the random draw.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.mandatoryBilleting.Desc: Billeting orders of the Empire arrive even below Overbooked. Off: only on hard tiers (Overbooked and higher). Either way only in a colony with guest beds.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.nobleBasePrice: Noble stay base price per noble and day
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.nobleBasePrice.Desc: Silver per noble and day before the title bonus (+15 % per 100 seniority) and the satisfaction factor.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.nobleMoneyFactor.Desc: Follows the guest-money row of the difficulty table: richer on easy tiers, poorer on hard ones.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.nobleStays.Desc: Nobles of the Empire may ask for paid lodging. You can always decline. Needs a guest bed in a bedroom that meets their title; they stay as guests and pay at the end, by how happy they were.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.shrineReactions: Colonists react to shrines of other faiths
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.shrineReactions.Desc: Proselytizers and supremacists dislike shrines of other faiths on their land; tolerant ideoligions like them.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.dlc.xenoHospitality.Desc: Guests' xenotypes and genes shape what rooms and goods they like (dark rooms for sanguophages, cold rooms for yttakin, ...).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.fallbackWindow: Investments in the comms console menu
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.fallbackWindow.Desc: Also offer the investment screens in the comms console float menu, even when the bank window is available.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.hazardMult.Desc: Multiplies crashes, rug pulls, defaults, exchange hacks and bank runs. The long-run average does not change, only how often it hurts.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.jumpMult.Desc: Multiplies how often assets make their own jumps (quarterly numbers, crypto jumps, memecoin pumps). The long-run average does not change: the maths compensates.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.memeInterval.Desc: Average number of days until the next memecoin is listed.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.memeOn.Desc: A new memecoin appears every few days and is delisted after three. Most holders lose money, a few get rich.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.newsMessages.Desc: Show crashes, rallies and hacks as short messages (only when you hold something affected).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.nftOn.Desc: Ownership certificates of pictures. Selling takes one to four days and costs a spread.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.omenCapA.Desc: Largest share of your net worth in one Omen chance market.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.omenCapB.Desc: Largest share of your net worth in one Omen market on a world event.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.omenFee.Desc: Share of every stake kept by the exchange (and again when you close a position early).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.omenGamma.Desc: Below 1 the exchange overprices unlikely outcomes (the classic favourite–longshot bias). 1 = quotes equal the true odds.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.omenSpread.Desc: Bookmaker's margin: the YES price and the NO price add up to 1 plus this.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.profit.Desc: How much invested money grows on average per game year (60 days) for the reference fund RimIndex 50: 1.2 means +20 % a year, 1.0 means plus/minus nothing, below 1 loses money. Log scale 0.1 to 100; type a number for the exact value. Follows the difficulty slider until you set it yourself.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.projectStakePct.Desc: Largest stake on one project, as share of your net worth.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.projectTotalPct.Desc: Largest total of all open project bets (Longs and Shorts together), as share of your net worth.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.projectYearCapPct.Des: Net profit from Longs and Shorts per game year is capped at this share of your net worth at the start of the year. Above it the bank pays the stake back only.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.projectsOn.Desc: Factions announce projects; you can invest (Long) or bet against them (Short).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.finance.volMult.Desc: Multiplies how wildly prices swing day to day. 1 = the numbers of the design (index 1.5 % a day, memecoins 15 %).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.assessmentDays.Desc: An accident plan assesses the invalidity grade this many days after the accident (a quadrum by default). Until then the letter shows a preview.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.billingDays.Desc: Premiums are debited automatically every this many days (from the bank account, otherwise the till or silver in storage).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.changeFee.Desc: What Clawback Mutual charges for every change of sum, tier or add-ons of a running policy ("administrative effort"). Free on Standard Room.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.changeLimitPerQuadr: How often one policy may be changed per quadrum. 0 = unlimited (Standard Room); Overbooked and harder levels limit it.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.changeWaitingDays.D: After you raise the sum, the tier or add an add-on, claims for events inside this waiting period are still assessed with the old cover (a policy raised one minute before a raid does not pay at the new level). Lowering cover has no waiting period.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.claimLetters.Desc: Clawback Mutual writes a letter for every filed claim (at most one "claim filed" notice per day) and every decision.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.claimMode.Desc: By form: an insured event brings a "claim possible" letter and you file the claim on a form before the deadline (the outcome is rolled exactly as before; the form is cosmetic apart from the payout choice). Automatic: claims are filed for you at the moment of damage.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.claimReminder: Remind me before a claim deadline
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.claimReminder.Desc: A short reminder letter two days before a filing window closes.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.claimsAttitude.Desc: How eagerly the claims department finds a reason not to pay. 0 % "Never weasels" · 15 % "Fine print" (Standard Room) · 40 % "Creative accounting" · 75 % "Our lawyers are bored" · 100 % "Basically always".
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.deadlineScale.Desc: Multiplies the filing deadline of every policy (Wanderlust 5 days, Legal Shield 5 days, property about 15 days at Good Enough; Premium +50 %, Bare Minimum -30 %).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.formError.Desc: Clause 30: the cancellation comes back with a form error. On Standard Room it is re-filed automatically and the deadline stays; harder levels lose a quadrum.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.formTextAi: AI reply to the claim statement
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.formTextAi.Desc: When the AI flavour module is on and you agreed to it, the claims department answers your statement in its own words (the amount and the outcome are not changed). Without it the statement is stored and ignored.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.hospitalCapDays: Rim Health Plan: paid sickbed days
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.hospitalCapDays.Des: The most sickbed days the Rim Health Plan pays per colonist inside the window below (a hospital-indemnity cap; it stops a chronic illness from paying more than the premium costs).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.hospitalCapWindow.D: The cap above counts the paid days of every colonist over this many days (a quadrum by default).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.loading.Desc: Surcharge on the expected damage that makes up the premium. On average the insurer keeps this share; 0 % is actuarially fair.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.maxPersonSum.Desc: Highest basic sum of an accident, retirement or travel policy (also at most twice the market value of the pawn).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.maxPropertySum.Desc: Highest sum insured of a property policy.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.negotiation.Desc: Claims can be negotiated (up to three rounds). On Standard Room negotiating never costs anything.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.noticeDays.Desc: A cancellation takes effect at the first quadrum change at least this many days after you file it. Standard Room 3 days, Overbooked one quadrum, "Why?" a year.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.pensionMaxWorkHours: Pension: allowed work hours per day
Hours per day a pensioner may have set to Work in the timetable. Anything, Joy, Sleep and Meditate count as free time.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.pensionRule.Desc: Whoever draws a daily pension (Golden Years, Good Enough or Premium, age 60+) may work only a few hours per day in the timetable. Enforce: strikes cost the pension (2nd: this period's pension, 3rd: the entitlement). Warn only: letters and the alert, no penalty. Off: no rule.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.requireResearch.Des: Policies unlock with the research projects SL_Insurance (Bare Minimum, Good Enough) and SL_Actuarial (Premium, Wanderlust). Off: everything is available at once.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.retentionDialogs.De: How many times Desmond Tally (Senior Retention Specialist) talks you out of cancelling. Standard Room: one honest offer.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.salesPressure.Desc: How hard Clawback Mutual sells: pre-ticked add-ons, retention offers, form errors, upsell hints. Each trick also has its own switch below.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.showStatusColumn: Insurance column in the colonist tables
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.showStatusColumn.De: Shows the insurance status of every colonist in the Assign table (only once the first policy exists).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.showStatusTab.Desc: Adds an Insurance tab to the inspector of colonists (only once the first policy exists).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.trick.badge.Desc: The badge on the Premium column (and, harder, the greyed-out "Premium Plus").
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.trick.formError.Des: Cancellations that come back with a form error.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.trick.preTicked.Des: Add-ons that are ticked for you (follows Sales pressure, always, or never).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.trick.upsell.Desc: Letters that suggest more or better cover (never within five days after a death).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.trickCap.Desc: All sales tricks together may cost at most this share of the yearly premiums; the rest is paid back as "Courtesy credit" in the yearly letter.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.insurance.waitingDays.Desc: Cover begins after this many days ("which begins after cover begins"). Damage inside the waiting period is not paid.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.colonyFee.Desc: Extra silver per ticket that you keep (it raises the price buyers see).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.colonyInterval.Desc: A draw every this many days; the jackpot rolls over.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.colonyJackpotCap.Desc: The jackpot of your lottery rolls over until this amount.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.colonyJackpotShare.De: Share of the pot for 4 right numbers.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.colonyOn.Desc: Run your own lottery: your guests and the simulated players of friendly settlements buy tickets, you keep what is not paid out.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.colonyPrice.Desc: Price of one ticket of your own lottery.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.colonyQuote.Desc: Share of the ticket price that goes into the pot. The rest is yours. A better share than the global draw attracts more buyers.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.colonySecondShare.Des: Share of the pot for 3 right numbers.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.colonyThirdShare.Desc: Share of the pot for 2 right numbers.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.demandBase.Desc: Tickets per person per day at neutral conditions, the base of the demand formula.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.globalInterval.Desc: A draw every this many days.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.globalOn.Desc: The global lottery: a draw every few days, tickets bought in the bank window.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.globalPrice.Desc: Price of one ticket of the global draw.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.globalQuote.Desc: Share of the ticket sales that goes into prizes (the jackpot gets 40 % of it).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.internationalScale.De: Multiplies the tickets the simulated players of all settlements buy for the global draw.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.lottery.jackpotCap.Desc: The jackpot rolls over until it reaches this amount.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.thrumbo.edgeShift.Desc: Percentage points added to the house edge of every Lucky Thrumbo game (base: slots 8 %, roulette 2.7 %, blackjack by the rules). 0 = the standard edges; negative numbers are in your favour. Follows the difficulty slider.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.thrumbo.maxBetCap.Desc: Only when the table limit is on: no stake is ever higher than this.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.thrumbo.maxBetFloor.Desc: Only when the table limit is on: even a poor colony may stake at least this much per round.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.thrumbo.maxBetShare: Lucky Thrumbo: table limit (share of net worth)
LanguageData.HH.Setting.thrumbo.maxBetShare.Desc: Only when the table limit is on: one stake may be at most this share of your net worth (account plus silver at home, minus debts), between the floor and the cap below.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.thrumbo.minBet.Desc: The smallest stake the Lucky Thrumbo accepts.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.thrumbo.tableLimit.Desc: When on, one stake is at most a share of your net worth (the three settings below). Off: you can stake everything you have.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.exposureChance: Chance a respectable guest stumbles on the back room
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.exposureChance.Des: Per check (about every 2 hours) while respectable guests are present and the back room was in use. Follows the difficulty slider.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.fence.buyPercent.D: Share of the market value the fence pays for stolen goods.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.fence.capital.Desc: The fence pays from its own cash box. It tops it up from the till, and surplus goes back to the till.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.fence.exposureChan: Per resold stolen item: the faction it was stolen from learns where it ended up.
Before the difficulty cap of your tier.
Share of the market value shady buyers pay.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.gang.demandHours: Hours to answer a protection demand
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.gang.demandHours.D: A demand you do not answer within this time counts as a refusal.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.gang.feeMin.Desc: What a gang member pays for the back room.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.gang.firstDays.Des: The first gang comes about this many days (half to one and a half times) after the first back room, fence counter or fight pit exists.
Average time between gang visits once the back room, fight pit or fence exists.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.gang.intimidateCha: Chance a gang demands protection money
Follows the difficulty slider; Standard Room and easier never forces anything on you but a dialog you can refuse.
Allows the holding cells tour (questioning of prisoners) for gang guests. Off by default; prisons are closed to every guest otherwise.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.gang.retryHours: Hours before a failed gang visit is tried again
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.gang.retryHours.De: When a gang cannot come (no friendly faction, no way onto the map), the next try is this many hours later.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.gang.tourFee.Desc: Paid by a gang member for questioning a prisoner for an hour.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.hunt.quarryCount.D: Animals the party brings into the hunting ground.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.hunt.quarryHours: Hours a human quarry must survive
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.hunt.quarryHours.D: A prisoner who survives this long or reaches the fence line is free.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.lounge.price.Desc: What a guest pays in the drug lounge. Guests only take what their ideology allows.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.organ.orderPremium: Grim only: a ready organ delivered within the deadline pays this many times the normal price.
Share of the market value the anonymous buyers pay.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.pit.betMax.Desc: Guests bet at most this much silver (and never more than a third of their budget).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.pit.betMin.Desc: Guests bet at least this much silver.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.pit.fairRatio.Desc: The stronger fighter may have at most this many times the combat power of the weaker one.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.pit.houseCut.Desc: The share of the betting pool the house keeps (totalisator).
A fight pit with enough fighters and spectators starts a bout this often.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.pit.maxBoutTicks.D: A bout nobody wins within this time is a draw: all stakes are returned.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.pit.yieldHealth.De: A bout ends when a fighter drops below this share of health, unless it is to the death.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.scandalCooldownDay: At most one scandal per map in this many days.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.smuggler.inspectCh: Per landing, if an imperial authority exists.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.smuggler.intervalD: Average time between night landings at a smuggler's dock.
Market value of the biggest crate offered.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.smuggler.offerHour: A boat you do not answer within this time leaves; nothing else happens.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.smuggler.priceFact: Share of the market value you pay for a crate.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.underworld.whispersDecay.Desc: Whispers lose this share of their value every 15 days.
